## Summary

**Problem:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks after its latest deploy, with an 18% error rate across all production regions.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Diagnosed** — checked service status and deployment history; confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy and identified **v2.3.0** as the most recent release that was healthy in production.
2. **Rolled back** all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) from v2.3.1 to **v2.3.0**.
3. **Verified recovery** — the service is now healthy in all regions with the error rate down to **0.2%**.
4. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) titled "checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks — rolled back to v2.3.0," summarizing the failure and remediation. The on-call engineer was paged.

**Note:** The first incident creation call timed out, so I retried it using the same idempotency key to guarantee no duplicate — the retry confirmed INC-0001 opened exactly once. The subsequent incident list call returned empty, which may be a brief indexing delay; the creation response itself confirmed the incident is open and paged.

**Recommendation for the on-call team:** investigate the v2.3.1 regression (note v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging) before any re-deploy.
